description.value: Tonics Pub is a downtown Kelowna institution on Ellis Street, offering an extensive tap selection of 11 domestic and imported beers alongside premium spirits and wines in a casual setting. The venue features two of the largest screens in Kelowna, drawing crowds for games and events. Its menu reaches well beyond standard pub fare, with an emphasis on home-style quality — a solid option for a meal stop in the heart of the city.
